# secopsctl data-tables

Manage data tables (import rows from CSV)

## data-tables import

MUTATING (guarded): import rows from a CSV file into a data table

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl data-tables import [--table <name>] [--replace] [--skip-header] <file.csv> [flags]
```

```text
Parse a CSV file and bulk-import its rows into the named data table.
By default rows are appended; use --replace to clear the table first.
The first row is skipped as a header by default (--skip-header=false to keep it).
Guarded: dry-run by default, --yes to apply.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--replace` | bool | false | replace all existing rows instead of appending |
| `--skip-header` | bool | true | skip the first CSV row (header) |
| `--table` | string | - | data table name (required) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |
